In zgrep, `--color=auto` is effectively the same as `--color=never`.

- The `ColorMode` enum has three values: `never`, `always`, `auto` (src/main.zig:237).
- The comment says `auto` is "deliberately folded to `never`", because deciding it properly would need `isatty(stdout)`, which "is not worth the flag" (src/main.zig:235-236).
- The option's doc comment agrees: "auto degrades to never off a TTY" (src/main.zig:307). That wording is a bit softer than the other comment, which suggests no TTY check happens at all, so colour would never be on, even on a terminal.
- The default is `.never` (src/main.zig:308).

The context doesn't include the parsing code where `auto` is actually mapped, so I can't confirm exactly where the folding happens or whether a TTY check exists.
